name: Crossref
tagline: Open DOI metadata and citation API for scholarly works
description: Crossref provides a free REST API for querying DOI metadata across scholarly publications. Developers can look up works by DOI, search titles and authors, retrieve citations and references, and access funder and member data. Polite pool access with a contact email is recommended for better rate limits; no API key is required for basic use.

auth.details: No API key required. Polite pool access via mailto query parameter or User-Agent with contact email is recommended for better rate limits and support.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public REST API with no hard published free-tier quota; polite pool (mailto/User-Agent) recommended for better/more consistent rate limits—not unlimited as a guaranteed SLA

rate_limits: Single-record: 5 RPS public / 10 RPS polite (concurrency 1 / 3). List/query requests: 1 RPS public / 3 RPS polite (concurrency 1 / 3). Limits in headers x-rate-limit-limit, x-rate-limit-interval, x-concurrency-limit, x-rate-limit-type; HTTP 429 when exceeded.
use_cases: resolve a DOI to full bibliographic metadata
search scholarly works by title author or keyword
get citation and reference lists for a paper
look up funder identifiers and related works
validate or enrich DOIs in a research dataset
